upstream.description: A plugin marketplace for Claude Code/GitHub Copilot that provides Power Platform development plugins, including reusable skills, agents, and commands for building and deploying solutions.

classification.analysis: Power Platform Skills is Microsoft's official Claude Code / GitHub Copilot plugin marketplace providing skills, agents, and commands for building Power Platform solutions: Power Pages code sites, model-driven Power Apps, MCP App widgets, Power Apps code and mobile apps, Canvas Apps, and Power Automate cloud flows. It installs via a one-line installer or in-CLI `/plugin` commands, is evaluated with a built-in eval harness, and ships telemetry with documented opt-out controls. Aimed at low-code/Power Platform developers who want AI-coding-assistant-driven scaffolding and deployment for Microsoft's business-app platform.

use_cases.title: Build a Power Apps model-driven app from a natural-language spec
Scaffold a Power Pages code site with an AI coding assistant
Author and debug Power Automate flows via an MCP server
